definitions.loss: lost good results / all eligible good results
definitions.activation: selected per-depth candidates / pre-exclusion design population
definitions.correction_reference_population: eligible nodes (phase-1 reference metric); current LMR does not use static evaluation
definitions.correction_common_population: direction-confirming non-mate observations with a noncapture best move and no royal attack; predictions read before update
definitions.correction_selection: maximize common error improvement; apply 10% improvement and 5% nonzero gates on that common population; exact ties use A before B, then royals/material/combined, then 32/64/128
definitions.improving_moves: quiet_expanded + LMR outside sample 2; numerator=futility + LMR - both; overlapping moves count once
definitions.improving_population_overlap: all eligible-node LMR quiets occur in sample 2; protected TT quiets counted by quiet_expanded; PV/deep/mate-window LMR quiets counted separately by depth
definitions.improving_first_moves: LMR judgments on first moves and capped moves count in the denominator, but never as reduction changes
definitions.improving_lmr_gate: remove extra LMR if all-depth loss increases by more than 10 percentage points; undefined loss is disclosed and does not itself trigger removal
definitions.capture_columns: depth index best_ok royal_ok improving see see_negative promote pruned good; pruned good is unknown and excluded from targets and good counts
definitions.lmr_columns: depth index history current_reduction new_reduction new_good current_good full_good overlaps_sample2
definitions.pooled_selection: all.selected is descriptive; actual activation applies per-depth selections
